_meta.indication: TREANDA (bendamustine hydrochloride) for Injection is indicated for the treatment of patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). Efficacy relative to first line therapies other than chlorambucil has not been established.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, randomized, controlled multicenter trial comparing TREANDA to chlorambucil; patients randomly assigned (1:1) to bendamustine 100 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2 or chlorambucil 0.8 mg/kg orally on days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
pivotal_trials.population: Previously-untreated patients with Binet Stage B or C (Rai Stages I-IV) CLL requiring treatment.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary efficacy endpoints: overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS).
pivotal_trials.n: 301 patients randomly assigned (TREANDA N=153, chlorambucil N=148).
pivotal_trials.result: Overall response rate 59% TREANDA vs 26% chlorambucil (p<0.0001); median PFS 18 vs 6 months, hazard ratio 0.27 (95% CI 0.17, 0.43), p<0.0001.

key_safety: Most common hematologic AEs (any grade >15%): neutropenia (28%), thrombocytopenia (23%), anemia (19%), leukopenia (18%). Most common non-hematologic AEs (>15%): pyrexia (24%), nausea (20%), vomiting (16%). Serious risks include myelosuppression, infections, infusion reactions/anaphylaxis, tumor lysis syndrome, and skin reactions.
target_moa: Bendamustine is a bifunctional nitrogen mustard (mechlorethamine) derivative / alkylating agent that dissociates into electrophilic alkyl groups forming covalent bonds with electron-rich nucleophilic moieties, leading to cell death; exact mechanism remains unknown.

rems.type: No REMS are recommended at this time.

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because the improvements in response rate and progression-free survival were clinically and statistically robust and the safety profile is comparable to other CLL therapies.

orphan_indication.text: Bendamustine has orphan drug exclusivity for the use in CLL.

citations.quote: PREA is not applicable because the applicant has orphan drug exclusivity for the use of bendamustine in CLL.

basis.text: The application received Priority review designation (Priority Designation P).

summary.text: TREANDA received Priority review and was approved on a single Phase 3 randomized open-label trial (Study 02CLLIII) comparing bendamustine with chlorambucil; the applicant held orphan drug exclusivity for use in CLL. It was not a referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee. This was a standard (non-accelerated) full approval.

citations.quote: Study 02CLLIII was a phase 3, randomized, open-label, multicenter study to evaluate the clinical efficacy and safety of bendamustine compared with chlorambucil in the treatment of previously untreated adults with symptomatic Binet stage B or stage C CLL requiring treatment.
PREA is not applicable because the applicant has orphan drug exclusivity for the use of bendamustine in CLL.

requirement.text: Provide an updated study report of Protocol 02CLLIII (Phase III study of bendamustine vs chlorambucil in treatment-naive B-CLL) at data cutoff in May 2008 including response rate, progression-free survival, overall survival and safety updates.

citations.quote: Cephalon commits to providing an updated study report of Protocol 02CLLIII titled "Phase III, Open-Label, Randomized, Multicenter Efficacy and Safety Study of Bendamustine Hydrochloride Versus Chlorambucil in Treatment-Naive Patients with (Binet Stage B/C) B-CLL Requiring Therapy" at data cut off date in May 2008.

requirement.text: Submit the results and data from ADME Study 1039, an open-label study of the pharmacokinetics (distribution, metabolism, excretion) of [14C]bendamustine following IV infusion in patients with relapsed or refractory malignancy.

citations.quote: Cephalon commits to submitting the results and data from the ADME Study 1039 titled "An Open-Label Study to Investigate the Pharmacokinetics (Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion) of Bendamustine Hydrochloride Following Intravenous Infusion of [14C]Bendamustine Hydrochloride in Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Malignancy (Hematologic or Nonhematologic)".

requirement.text: Conduct a study to assess the potential for bendamustine to prolong the QT interval in patients.

citations.quote: Cephalon commits to conducting a study to assess the potential for bendamustine to prolong the QT interval in patients. The QT plan will be submitted prior to initiation for IRT review and concurrence.

requirement.text: Perform an in vivo drug interaction study of the ability of fluvoxamine (CYP1A2 inhibitor) to alter the pharmacokinetics of a single dose of bendamustine.

citations.quote: Since bendamustine is a CYP1A2 substrate *in vitro*, Cephalon agrees to perform an *in vivo* drug interaction study of the ability of fluvoxamine (CYP1A2 inhibitor) to alter the pharmacokinetics of a single dose of bendamustine.
